title: Checkout test fails: button not found after UI refactor
label: locator
error: locator.click: Test timeout exceeded. waiting for getByTestId('checkout-button')
resolution: Developers renamed data-testid from checkout-button to pay-button. Updated the test locator.

title: All UI tests fail at start: connection refused
label: environment
resolution: Test server did not start in CI. Added a health check and waited for the server before running tests.

title: Search results test fails randomly
label: flaky
error: expect(locator).toHaveCount(5) Expected 5 Received 0, passes on retry
resolution: Test asserted before the API response arrived. Added a wait for the network response.

title: Welcome message shows wrong user name
label: app_bug
error: expect(locator).toHaveText Expected: Welcome, student! Received: Welcome, undefined!
resolution: Real application bug: the login handler did not store the username. Fixed in backend.

title: Profile page test cannot find save button
label: locator
error: locator.click: Test timeout exceeded. waiting for getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' })
resolution: Button text was changed to 'Save changes'. Updated the test to the new button name.

title: API returns server error during test run
label: environment
resolution: Staging database was restarting during the nightly run. Rescheduled the job.
